name: pretture-erp-ai
description: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Pretture ERP analytics through a secure MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Pretture ERP gives authorized teams secure ChatGPT access to configured ERP analytics and operational reporting. Users can discover enabled ERP APIs, run backend-calculated reports, and review sales and operations metrics from their connected Pretture account. Credentials are handled by the Pretture MCP backend, available capabilities are controlled by the API Registry, and the plugin does not expose raw credentials or perform payments.
defaultPrompt: Compare sales by month for this year.
